scores.evidence: Each of the 3 objectives still has 3 or more graded items with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, q5, e5, e6), and the e2 and e4 rewrites keep their objectiveId. o1 is still 'create / 設計できる' and is assessed only by selection. e1 and e2 still carry bloom 'create', and no practice step asks the learner to design a check.

hook-lead sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences ('「完了しました。正しく動作します」…翌日、別の入力でエラーが出ました。何があれば防げたでしょうか。'), with no trivia, followed by the predict item q0 (o1). The distractors are now tempting: c '依頼文に「テストも書いて」と一言だけ足す', and d is reading the report line by line.

s1-table now gives the English on first use ('ビルド（build）', 'スクリーンショット（screenshot）比較'). s2-goal keeps 'ターン（turn）' ahead of its use and names the judge ('判定役（この小さなモデル）'). The prerequisites and the 第1回 agentic-loop recall in s1-why are unchanged.

measure.mjs: 'prose 2012 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)'. lint --strict shows 0 warnings. s1-why and s2-goal are now split into shorter paragraphs, and s1-table and p-model-sort are 2 columns. 4-4 is still the heaviest section, with 10 blocks, and 4-2 still holds two ideas (evidence and /goal).

In 4-3 (example), s3-steps gives 5 labelled subgoals, each with its reason ('関数がないと、テストは読み込みで止まります'; '失敗を先に見ると、テストが新しいコードを試しているとわかります') and a correct expect ('fail 4', then 'pass 4・fail 0', then a diff of only postal.mjs). The two prompts and the test code follow. The practice repeats the flow with fewer explanations, but it is still fully prompted rather than independent.

Every content section still ends with an applied inline quiz that has feedback on every wrong option. The rewritten q1 key 'b' ('「直した画面を画像と見比べ、ずれを直して」') is now shorter than distractor a, so length no longer cues the answer, and it does not copy s1-table's wording ('「撮って見本の画像と比べて」').

The reworded e4 option c ('型エラーは開発中だけの話なので、設定をそのまま残す') is now a concrete action. Its feedback names the error ('無視する設定を残すと、検証の手段が1つ減ります'). e2's distractor d still targets the 'the judge runs the command' misconception, and its feedback is corrective ('判定役はコマンドを実行せず、会話に出た結果だけを読みます').

s4-sort keeps its 5 nodes. The labels now wrap ('仕様どおりに
動かない', '必須：直して
テストを再実行') to fit a narrow screen, and the caption and alt are unchanged. s1-table and p-model-sort are 2-column comparisons with captions ('確認：合うタスク', '分類：理由'), and there are no decorative images.

p-prompt-write now says to export the empty function ('中身が空の `isLeapYear` をexportして置くだけにしてください'), so the load stop that 4-3 warns about cannot happen. The checklist p-c1 to p-c7 gives clear success criteria, and p-model-sort models the sorting. The hint ladder is still only 1–2 levels deep (p-evidence and p-commit have no added hints), and no step transfers o1.

summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps its reflection question ('手元のタスクに、どの確認を渡せますか。') and now names '第5回｜コンテキストを管理する'. The 7 flashcards are retrieval prompts, and card-test-first now reads as one sentence ('テストを書き、失敗を確かめてから、テストを変えずに通るまで実装します。').

Both items behind the previous score of 3 are fixed. card-fresh keeps the hedge ('甘くなりがちだからです'), and p-prompt-write exports the empty function. The e2 key ('「`npm test` の失敗が0件になる。…または20ターンで止める」') matches the /goal page's guidance in facts-cc-04-verify.md ('a stated check (e.g. "`npm test` exits 0")', 'or stop after 20 turns'). s2-goal keeps the audit-confirmed exits ('満たすか無理と判定される…進展がないときや、直す必要のあるエラーでも止まります').

The checklist items are now です・ます ('コミットしました', '変わっていません'), which matches the rest of the lesson. Lint finds no banned phrases, and the terms match the glossary. s2-goal still repeats 判定 in one sentence ('条件を判定し、満たすか無理と判定されるまで'); the wording belongs to the ja-editor.

The lesson is jp only and complete. s4-sort keeps its caption and descriptive alt, and the 2-column tables fit mobile. The links keep descriptive text ('[Chromeとの連携](…/chrome)', '[日本語の公式ドキュメント](…/ja/best-practices)'), and no text is baked into images.

summary: Verification round (review-scope exit 0: 11 of 57 blocks, 11%). The previous review had no must-fix items, so there is nothing to resolve. The authors applied 3 of its suggestions: the export in p-prompt-write, the hedge in card-fresh and a shorter e2 key. They also made the tables and diagram fit mobile, switched the checklist to です・ます and glossed ビルド and スクリーンショット on first use. All 11 changed blocks were reviewed in full, and none adds an error or regression: the q1, e2 and e4 rewrites keep their answers, feedback and objectiveIds, and no option gives its answer away. Accuracy rises to 4. validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs gives prose 2012 and est 19.3 against estMinutes 19. align and practice stay at 3, because o1 (create) is still assessed only by selection.
